name: vulture.exe
source:
Asuka is invited to an awards ceremony whose motivations claim to be sparking a cultural flame among the country’s young adults. Finding an irresistible offer scribbled inside the sealed envelope, she reluctantly accepts. Tragedy strikes as she and fifteen others are whisked away to an isolated building and forced to play a deadly game.

Four executioners are hiding amongst them, and they have to find out who they are before they’re all killed.

[From [url=https://k2studios.itch.io/vultureexe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
明日香受邀参加颁奖典礼，其动机据称是要在该国年轻人中点燃文化之火。她发现密封信封内潦草地写着一份令人难以抗拒的提议，她不情愿地接受了。悲剧发生了，她和另外十五个人被带到一栋孤立的建筑，被迫玩一场致命的游戏。

四名刽子手藏在他们中间，他们必须在全部被杀之前找出他们的身份。

[来自[url=https://k2studios.itch.io/vultureexe]itch.io[/url]]
